messages.content: Build a simple roller conveyor as separate editable solids, centered at the origin. There are 24 horizontal cylindrical rollers running across Z, each 90 cm long and 16 cm in diameter. Their axes are 85 cm above the ground, equally spaced at 20 cm along X and symmetric about the origin. Two side rails run along X, each 5.2 m long, 14 cm wide and 20 cm tall, with tops level with the roller axes. Place the rails so their inner faces meet the roller ends. Support each rail on four 8 cm square legs at X=-2.4, -0.8, 0.8 and 2.4 m, from the ground to the rail underside. Keep the 34 parts independently editable in an assembly; omit fine hardware and preserve the other objects.
